newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures close up in thin and rangebound trade.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures close up in thin and rangebound trade.

text.p: NYCE frozen concentrated orange juice futures closed slightly firmer as prices continued to drift within their recent trading range, market sources said.
Pressure remains on the downside, however, amid ample supplies.
Support basis the most-active January contract remained at 100.00 and resistance at 105.00.
January finished up 0.70 at 103.05, having ranged from 103.40 to 102.10. The back months ended 0.50 to 1.05 higher.
The deferred May and July contract hit contract lows during today's session.
